title: Nearest-available booking asks only one first-visit gating question
description: The caller asks for the nearest available appointment without saying whether this is the first visit. To avoid pre-tool silence and unnecessary clarifications, the assistant should spend the first turn only on the first-visit gate, then issue checkAvailability immediately on the next turn once the caller confirms a first visit.
